The dev-agent's MainPage includes a NavigationView header + StatusPanel (MaxHeight=200) that consume viewport height. Skill should recommend MinHeight on media elements or warn about layout constraints in multi-control pages.

summary: Score 77/100. Builds and runs. 4 of 7 requirements pass fully. Requirements 3, 4, 7 are partial because MediaPlayerElement is squeezed to zero height in scenarios with heavy control content. The root cause is the shell layout: NavigationView header + StatusPanel consume ~250px of viewport height, and scenarios with many Auto-height controls (radio buttons, ComboBoxes, DVR controls) overflow the remaining space, leaving nothing for the MediaPlayerElement's Height='*' row. Scenarios 2, 5, 6 work because they have fewer controls above the MediaPlayerElement. The CS0104 HttpClient ambiguity was the only build error and was fixed in one turn.
